name: io.github.asskergarry/ai-operating-architecture-standard
title: AI-OS Documentation Server
description: Read-only access to an AI-OS governed documentation deployment: list the document registry, fetch any capability or execution module by ID, and search across official documents — so a model pulls governance content on demand instead of carrying it in context. Standard-library only, no dependencies; paths are sandboxed and there is no write surface.

environmentVariables.name: AIOS_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the AI-OS deployment to serve (a clone of the AI-Operating-Architecture-Standard repository, or your own AI-OS-structured documentation root). If omitted, the server searches upward from the working directory.
